test_MessageToString: test MessageToString to serialize a protobuf message to human-readable text format
test_Parse: test Parse to deserialize a text-format string into a protobuf message object
test_Merge: test Merge to merge text-format data into an existing protobuf message
test_PrintField: test PrintField to output a single protobuf field in text format
test_PrintFieldValue: test PrintFieldValue to output only the value portion of a protobuf field
